title: AtlasTexture not compatible with particles and materials
body:
### Tested versions

v4.7.stable.official [5b4e0cb0f]

### System information

Godot v4.7.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 SUPER (NVIDIA; 32.0.16.1074) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10700K CPU @ 3.80GHz (16 threads) - 63.74 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Utilizing AtlasTextures in my project has been eye opening about the process of managing my 2d assets, however I have found that the AtlasTexture is incompatible with multiple different parts of Godot such as the 2d particle nodes and the 3d Materials such as the StandardMaterial3D and PanoramaSkyMaterial.

Observed behavior:
Sprite2D, animated Sprite2D - works completely fine takes the correct region of the image that the atlas texture is set to.
CPU and GPU Particles2D - If the AtlasTexture has another AtlasTexture as the Atlas (nested AtlasTexture) the particle displayed is the incorrect region of the original AtlasTexture, the size of the region depicted by the Atlas is respected though, so if the source is 128x128 and the atlas is 16x16 region then what is displayed is a 16x16 region of Source.
Source (not an AtlasTexture) -> AtlasA -> AtlasB => Particle2D => Source
(should be of AtlasB)
However for non nested atlas textures it works perfectly fine:
Source (not an AtlasTexture)->AtlasA =>Particle2D => AtlasA

StandardMaterial, PanoramaSkyMaterial (probably more) - Atlas Textures dont remotely work here, they default to just showing the source fully without region


### Steps to reproduce

Create an image Source create 2 atlasTextures A and B
set A's atlas to Source, set B's atlas to A
Create a new scene with CPU or GPU particles, set texture to A or B and observe the particles

For seeing it for materials simply set the relative Texture2D parameter to A or B and observe the change

"N/A"
